objective: Create one pure domain planner for manual insurance lead operating-state changes before adding any new persistence or River OS mutation surface.

identity.rule: The relationship and insurance lead profile must reference the same canonical relationshipId.

targetState.assignedProducer: Optional manual normalized text; null or omission means the target state is unassigned.

transitionPolicy.rule: No new restrictive transition graph is invented in INS-006Q.
transitionPolicy.reason: The existing CRM and insurance domains define valid state vocabularies but do not define a closed transition graph. INS-006Q validates complete target state through those canonical domain constructors.

timePolicy.rule: A changed record receives occurredAt as updatedAt.
timePolicy.monotonicity: occurredAt must not precede the current updatedAt of any record actually changed.
timePolicy.noOp: No-op plans preserve the current records and do not manufacture an update timestamp.

auditPolicy.stageChanges: A changed CRM pipeline stage requires an immutable stage-changed relationship event.
auditPolicy.nonStageChanges: Quote-status-only or producer-only changes do not misuse the stage-changed event type. A broader event type is deferred until explicitly modeled.

excluded: River OS form or route wiring
